name: Complete Blood Count (CBC)
description: A fundamental diagnostic tool that evaluates the overall health of your blood, screening for a wide range of disorders including anemia, infection, and leukemia.

name: Basic Metabolic Panel (BMP)
description: A blood test that measures your body's electrolyte and fluid balance, kidney function, and blood sugar levels.

name: Lipid Panel
description: A group of tests that measure the amount of cholesterol and triglycerides in your blood.
